why: The factor is given the curator's name, so two declarations carry one name and both stand in the hall from world init: the party sees one person twice, at the lectern and at the counter. It declares no unit: both halves are legal on their own — an NPC may be called anything, and two NPCs may stand in one hall — and what the engine refuses is holding them at once. Before this refusal existed the build was green and the bot walked it; nothing compared one body's name with another's.
